summary: The uploaded webhook certificate exceeds the server’s size limit.

match_any.description_template: Bad Request: certificate size is too big ({size_bytes} bytes)

possible_causes: The uploaded certificate file is larger than MAX_CERTIFICATE_FILE_SIZE.
diagnostic_limits: The captured size describes the rejected upload; it is not the configured limit or a Telegram media limit.

evidence.note: The description interpolates the actual file size; one literal string cannot represent all responses.
The constant is 3 << 20 bytes in this revision.

response.description: Bad Request: certificate size is too big (4194304 bytes)

preconditions: Verify that the uploaded file is the intended certificate and satisfies this server revision's limit.
